findings.description: Anyone can launch an instance from AMI 'ami-0dec0b0b11c000002' and read its volumes.
findings.remediation: Make the AMI private (remove the 'all' launch permission) and turn on AMI Block Public Access.
findings.title: AMI ami-0dec0b0b11c000002 is public

findings.description: Account 999999999999 can launch instances from AMI 'ami-0dec0000000000002' (launch permission).

findings.title: AMI ami-0dec0000000000002 is shared with account 999999999999

findings.description: These methods/routes have no effective authorisation (NONE): anyone who can reach the endpoint can invoke the Lambda function.
findings.remediation: Attach an authorizer (IAM, Cognito, JWT or Lambda) to the listed routes, or confirm that unauthenticated access is intended.
findings.title: API 'demo-http-api' has 1 Lambda route(s) without authentication

findings.description: These methods/routes have no effective authorisation (NONE): anyone who can reach the endpoint can invoke the Lambda function.

findings.title: DynamoDB table 'demo-orders' is shared with 999999999999

findings.description: The snapshot's createVolumePermission includes the 'all' group: anyone can create a volume from it and read the data.
findings.remediation: Remove the public createVolumePermission and set snapshot Block Public Access to block-all-sharing.
findings.title: EBS snapshot 'snap-0dec0b0b11c000021' is shared publicly

findings.description: Account 999999999999 can create volumes from the snapshot (createVolumePermission).

findings.description: Instance 'i-0dec0eeb000000002' (running) has public address(es) 203.0.113.10; security group(s) sg-0dec0eeb000000002 admit 0.0.0.0/0 on 22/tcp.
findings.remediation: Restrict the security-group ingress to specific source ranges, or move the instance behind a load balancer in a private subnet.
findings.title: Instance i-0dec0eeb000000002 is reachable from the internet on 22/tcp

findings.description: Instance 'i-0dec0eeb000000002' (running) has HttpTokens 'optional' with the metadata endpoint enabled: SSRF can read the instance role's temporary credentials.
findings.remediation: Set HttpTokens to 'required' to enforce IMDSv2 (or disable the metadata endpoint).
findings.title: Instance i-0dec0eeb000000002 allows IMDSv1 (instance role exposed to SSRF)

findings.description: Instance 'i-0dec0eeb000000002' has public address(es) 203.0.113.10 and its subnet's effective route table routes to an attached internet gateway.
findings.remediation: Move the instance to a private subnet or remove its public address.
findings.title: Instance i-0dec0eeb000000002 has a public address in an internet-routed subnet

findings.description: The launch template 'demo-web-lt' has user data (content not collected). User data is readable by anyone with ec2:DescribeInstanceAttribute / DescribeLaunchTemplateVersions and through IMDS on the host; review it for embedded credentials.
findings.remediation: Review the user data for embedded credentials; move secrets to Secrets Manager or SSM SecureString parameters read at boot.
findings.title: User data is present on launch template demo-web-lt

findings.description: The registry permission policy grants replication or repository creation to principals outside this account, so they can place images in this registry.
findings.remediation: Remove registry-policy grants (ReplicateImage, CreateRepository) to accounts that should not write into this registry.
findings.title: ECR registry in eu-west-2 lets 999999999999 write images

findings.description: Registry replication rules copy images to registries of other accounts.
findings.remediation: Verify that cross-account replication destinations are intended and trusted.
findings.title: ECR images in eu-west-2 replicate to 999999999999

findings.description: The ecr repository's resource policy grants ecr:BatchGetImage, ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer to principals of account(s) 999999999999, independently of this account's IAM policies.
findings.remediation: Verify cross-account pull/push access is intended.
findings.title: ECR repository 'demo-api' is shared with 999999999999

findings.description: The access-entry mapping of arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/demo-admin-role gives it full control of cluster demo-cluster (access policy AmazonEKSClusterAdminPolicy). Whoever can use this IAM principal controls every workload, secret and service-account identity of the cluster.
findings.remediation: Review which IAM principals are mapped to system:masters or AmazonEKSClusterAdminPolicy; prefer namespaced access policies.
findings.title: arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/demo-admin-role is a cluster administrator of EKS cluster demo-cluster

findings.description: The access-entry mapping of arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/demo-admin-role gives it full control of cluster demo-west-cluster (access policy AmazonEKSClusterAdminPolicy). Whoever can use this IAM principal controls every workload, secret and service-account identity of the cluster.

findings.description: The Kubernetes API endpoint of cluster demo-cluster (eu-west-2) is publicly accessible from 0.0.0.0/0. Authentication is still required, but any leaked kubeconfig, token or mapped IAM credential is usable from anywhere, and API-server vulnerabilities are exposed.
findings.remediation: Disable public endpoint access, or restrict publicAccessCidrs to known administration networks.

findings.description: The load balancer scheme is 'internet-facing': its listeners (22/tcp, 443/tcp) are reachable from the internet and forward to its targets.

findings.title: Load balancer 'demo-public-alb' is internet-facing

findings.remediation: Remove hostNetwork: true.

findings.description: The pod shares the host's network namespace (every node interface, the node's IMDS).
findings.remediation: Remove hostNetwork: true.

findings.description: The pod mounts directories of the node that give control of the node or its container runtime.
findings.remediation: Replace hostPath volumes by persistent volumes or projected sources; never mount the container runtime socket, the kubelet directory or the node's root filesystem.
findings.title: Pod mounts a hostPath volume (demo-apps/demo-worker-0, cluster demo-cluster)

findings.description: The pod shares the host's PID namespace (it can see and signal every process on the node).

findings.description: The pod-identity configuration of demo-apps/demo-worker names arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/demo-app-role, but the role's trust policy does not admit it (trust policy: not_allowed (trust_policy)). The pods get no AWS credentials from it; the configuration is stale or was planted, and is not an attack path.
findings.remediation: Remove the stale eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn annotation or Pod Identity association, or fix the role's trust policy if the workload needs it.
findings.title: Service account names an IAM role whose trust does not admit it (demo-apps/demo-worker, cluster demo-cluster)

findings.description: The irsa configuration of kube-system/aws-node names arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/demo-eks-node-role, but the role's trust policy does not admit it (trust policy: not_allowed (trust_policy)). The pods get no AWS credentials from it; the configuration is stale or was planted, and is not an attack path.
findings.remediation: Remove the stale eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn annotation or Pod Identity association, or fix the role's trust policy if the workload needs it.
findings.title: Service account names an IAM role whose trust does not admit it (kube-system/aws-node, cluster demo-cluster)

findings.description: Service demo-apps/demo-api-lb of type LoadBalancer gets an internet-facing AWS load balancer (in-tree cloud provider default (internet-facing)), open to any source address.

findings.description: Ingress demo-apps/demo-api-ingress routes to demo-api-lb without an authentication annotation (alb.ingress.kubernetes.io/scheme: internet-facing). Verify that the backends authenticate requests.

findings.description: S3 bucket 'demo-legacy-eu-bucket' gives anyone on the internet access (actions unknown: the policy could not be read); not verified: s3:GetBucketPolicy:denied.
findings.remediation: Remove the wildcard Principal or scope it with a principal-restricting condition (aws:PrincipalOrgID, aws:SourceVpce, aws:SourceArn); keep Block Public Access (RestrictPublicBuckets) on at account level.

findings.description: S3 bucket 'demo-public-site' gives anyone on the internet CAN_READ (actions: s3:getobject).

findings.description: S3 bucket 'demo-public-site' gives anyone on the internet CAN_READ.

findings.description: With the classic flow an identity can call AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity on any role whose trust policy admits this pool, bypassing the configured roles and mappings.
findings.remediation: Set AllowClassicFlow=false and make every role trust policy require the pool id (aud) and the expected amr.
findings.title: Cognito identity pool 'demo_identity_pool' allows the classic (basic) authentication flow

findings.description: With the classic flow an identity can call AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity on any role whose trust policy admits this pool, bypassing the configured roles and mappings.

findings.title: Cognito identity pool 'demo_roles_denied_pool' allows the classic (basic) authentication flow

findings.description: Access key AKIAEXAMPLEALICE0001 has not been rotated for 728 days (limit 90) and has not been used recently: deactivate it.
findings.remediation: Rotate the key (create a new one, switch, deactivate and delete the old one) or delete it if unused; prefer short-lived role credentials.

findings.description: A policy of the function lets arn:aws:iam::999999999999:root (account 999999999999) perform lambda:invokefunction.
findings.remediation: Verify cross-account invoke access is intended.
findings.title: Lambda 'demo-layered' grants access to account 999999999999

findings.description: The layer version policy lets any AWS account read the layer (lambda:GetLayerVersion): its code and any configuration or credentials packaged in it are exposed.
findings.remediation: Remove the public statement from the layer version policy (RemoveLayerVersionPermission) or restrict it to an organisation (aws:PrincipalOrgID).
findings.title: Lambda layer version 'demo-deps:3' is public

findings.description: The SNS policy lets arn:aws:iam::999999999999:root (account 999999999999) perform sns:publish.
findings.remediation: Verify cross-account access is intended.

findings.description: In region eu-west-1: no enabled GuardDuty detector.
